# rustler_precompiled v0.9.0 - Table of Contents

Make the usage of precompiled NIFs easier for projects using Rustler

## Pages

- [Precompilation guide](https://rustler-precompiled.hexdocs.pm/precompilation_guide.md)
- [Changelog](https://rustler-precompiled.hexdocs.pm/changelog.md)
- [Troubleshooting](https://rustler-precompiled.hexdocs.pm/troubleshooting.md)

## Modules

- [RustlerPrecompiled](https://rustler-precompiled.hexdocs.pm/RustlerPrecompiled.md): Download and use precompiled NIFs safely with checksums.

## Mix Tasks

- [mix rustler_precompiled.download](https://rustler-precompiled.hexdocs.pm/Mix.Tasks.RustlerPrecompiled.Download.md): A task responsible for downloading the precompiled NIFs for a given module.
